pwa_update_ready: A new version of Kern is ready

roles_builtin_guest: Sees only what they are explicitly given

roles_builtin_owner: Full control, including deleting the workspace

security_2fa_hint: Require a code from your authenticator app when signing in.

security_passkey_hint: Replaces your password on devices that support it.
security_passkeys_hint: Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID or a security key.
security_sessions_hint: Devices signed in to your account.

tracker_approval_who: Only the people this approval is addressed to can decide it.
tracker_attachment_failed: The file could not be uploaded

tracker_comment_internal_hint: Only people in this workspace see this. The requester does not.
tracker_cycle_complete_body: Closing {name}. Anything unfinished moves where you say.
tracker_cycle_range_error: A cycle cannot end before it starts.
tracker_empty_body: Nothing matches this filter. Clear it, or press C to create the first issue.
tracker_error_body: The issue list could not be loaded.
tracker_field_delete_body: The field goes, and so does its value on every issue that has one. Nothing brings those back.
tracker_field_key_fixed: The key cannot change: it is where every value is already stored.
tracker_field_key_hint: Lower case, letters, digits and underscores. Used in queries as cf.<key>.
tracker_field_not_editable: This field cannot be edited here yet
tracker_field_options_required: Give every choice a name, and add at least one.
tracker_field_pattern_invalid: That is not a valid pattern.
tracker_field_required_hint: People must fill it in before saving.
tracker_field_searchable_hint: Its text is found by workspace search.
tracker_field_type_fixed: The type cannot change: it is what validates the values already saved.

tracker_hierarchy_same_level: Something may hold another of its own kind — a task under a task
tracker_hierarchy_skip_levels: A level may be skipped — an epic holding a task with no story between
tracker_import_file_hint: A CSV. It is read here in the browser first, so you can check the columns before anything is sent.
tracker_import_has_header: The first row is column names
tracker_import_history_hint: What each one did. Open one to see the rows it could not bring in.
tracker_import_mapping_hint: Nothing is mapped to begin with. A column left alone is not imported.
tracker_import_needs_title: One column has to be the title — an issue cannot be created without one.
tracker_intake_copy_manually: Select the link to copy it
tracker_intake_hint: A link anyone can use to raise something with this project. What they send arrives in triage.
tracker_intake_rotate_hint: Replacing it stops the old link working. Closing it stops all of them.
tracker_issue_delete_body: This deletes the work item with its comments, files and history. It cannot be undone — archiving keeps all of it and takes the item off every list.
tracker_layout_hint: Drag a field to move it. Locked fields are always shown.
tracker_layout_main_hint: Down the middle of the issue.
tracker_level_0_hint: The everyday one — a task, a bug, a story
tracker_level_sub_hint: Only ever sits under something else
tracker_no_description: No description yet — click to write one.
tracker_no_permission: You do not have permission to change this
tracker_planning_components_hint: The parts of the thing you are building.
tracker_planning_cycles_hint: Fixed windows of work — a sprint, an iteration, a week. One runs at a time.
tracker_planning_labels_hint: Free-form tags anyone on the project can use.
tracker_planning_milestones_hint: What a stretch of work is aiming at, whenever it lands.
tracker_planning_remove_body: Remove “{name}”? It comes off every issue that has it.
tracker_planning_versions_hint: What you are shipping, and what shipped already.
tracker_project_behaviour_hint: What this project counts in, and whether it triages and runs cycles.
tracker_project_delete_body: This deletes the project and every work item, comment and file in it. It cannot be undone.
tracker_project_key_fixed: The key cannot change: it is in every issue reference, link and saved query.
tracker_project_key_hint: Two to ten capitals. Issues are numbered from it: KERN-1.
tracker_project_lifecycle_hint: Archiving takes it off the menus and keeps everything. Deleting keeps nothing.
tracker_project_template_hint: What the project tracks, and what each kind of item shows. You can change all of it later.
tracker_project_triage: Hold new work in triage before the backlog
tracker_repeat_hint: Something you set up once and then have to trust, so it says exactly what it will do.
tracker_repeat_note: Each one raises an issue with this name. Open it afterwards to fill in the rest.
tracker_report_burndown_hint: What is left in this cycle, against what would be left if it went evenly.

tracker_report_empty: Nothing to show for this period yet
tracker_report_flow_hint: Whether the pile is growing or shrinking.
tracker_report_no_cycle: This project has no cycle yet, so there is nothing to burn down.
tracker_report_time_hint: Where the hours went in the last month.
tracker_report_velocity_hint: What the team took on and what it finished, cycle by cycle.
tracker_reports_no_projects: There are no projects to report on yet
tracker_reports_subtitle: How the work is going, rather than what it is.
tracker_settings_fields_empty_hint: Add one, then put it on a work item type.
tracker_settings_fields_failed: The fields could not be loaded.
tracker_settings_fields_hint: Everything a team can record beyond the built-in properties. Each work item type decides where its fields appear.
tracker_settings_import_hint: Bring work in from a spreadsheet. Nothing is imported until you say what each column means.
tracker_settings_planning_hint: How a project schedules and sorts its work. Each of these belongs to one project.
tracker_settings_projects_hint: What each project is called, how it behaves, and what happens when it is done.
tracker_settings_repeating_hint: Issues that create themselves, and templates for the ones you raise by hand.
tracker_settings_types_failed: The types could not be loaded.
tracker_settings_types_hint: What a team tracks, and what each kind of item shows.
tracker_settings_workflows_hint: The statuses work moves through, and what each move requires.
tracker_template_hint: A starting point for the issues somebody raises again and again.
tracker_time_running_elsewhere: A timer is running on another issue
tracker_triage_hint: This arrived from outside the team and has not been accepted yet.
tracker_type_archive_body: {name} comes off every menu. Work items already using it keep it, and nothing is deleted.
tracker_type_default_hint: One type is the default, so making this one replaces whichever holds it now.
tracker_type_key_fixed: The key cannot change: imports, saved queries and the API name this type by it.
tracker_type_key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Imports and the API name the type by this.
tracker_type_level_hint: What may sit above and below it. An epic can hold a story; a story cannot hold an epic.
tracker_type_make_default: Use this type for new work items
tracker_view_delete_body: The view goes; nothing it was showing does.
tracker_views_empty_hint: Build a query, then save it to come back to it.
tracker_workflow_invalid: The workflow was not saved — see what is wrong below.
tracker_workflow_no_template: That starting point is no longer available.
tracker_workflow_remove_body: The status and every move through it go. Work still sitting in it will stop this from saving.
tracker_workflow_start_from_hint: Every workflow starts from one of these. An empty one has no transitions, so no work could move through it.
tracker_workflow_status_add_hint: A new status can be reached from any other and left for any other. Narrow that in its transitions once it is in use.
tracker_workflow_statuses_hint: Rename them or change their order. An issue points at a status by id, so renaming one never moves anything.
tracker_workflow_transitions_hint: What each move requires, and what it does afterwards. Editing these is not built yet.
tracker_workflow_used_by_in: Work item types that run on {name}
tracker_workflow_used_by_label: Work item types that run on this workflow
tracker_workflow_used_by_none: Nothing uses this workflow yet, so it has no effect on anybody's work.
ws_archive_confirm_body: The workspace disappears for its members and its content stops appearing in search. Nothing is deleted, and an admin can restore it later.
ws_archive_hint: Hide this workspace for all members. Admins can restore it.
ws_auto_join_hint: People signing up with these email domains join automatically.
ws_default_role_hint: Applied to people who accept an invitation or join automatically.
ws_identity_hint: How this workspace appears to everyone in it.
ws_joining_hint: Who can get in, and what they can do when they arrive.
ws_slug_hint: Used in links to this workspace. Changing it breaks existing links, so it is fixed for now.
